from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Document(BaseModel):
    """A legal document with its title and assigned cause of action."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The document title/identifier, e.g., '判决文书 X'")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action (案由) for this document as extracted from the document")
    cause_category: str | None = Field(description="The broader legal category if distinguishable (e.g., 'civil', 'criminal', 'administrative', 'state_compensation')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[Document]
